name: svg-morpheus-ts
description: ESM TypeScript library enabling SVG icons to morph from one to the other. It implements Material Design's Delightful Details transitions. Refactored with modern TypeScript + Vite + pnpm stack. Supports both Chinese and English documentation.

scripts.build: tsc && vite build && vite build --mode core
scripts.test: pnpm build && node --test test/core.test.mjs test/lifecycle.test.mjs test/matching.test.mjs test/paint.test.mjs research/shared-boundaries.test.mjs research/shared-stroke.test.mjs research/shared-fill.test.mjs research/icon-gallery.test.mjs && pnpm test:types
scripts.test:types: tsc --noEmit --strict --moduleResolution NodeNext --module NodeNext --target ES2020 --lib ES2020 --types node test/core-types.ts
scripts.test:research: pnpm build && node --test research/shared-boundaries.test.mjs research/shared-stroke.test.mjs research/shared-fill.test.mjs research/icon-gallery.test.mjs
